hypothesis: Positive-regime noninferiority can be restored by reducing unnecessary defensive entries and limiting displacement from V8 while preserving immediate return to exact V8 scoring on the first non-negative decision.

development_data_policy.allowed_timestamp_rule: decision and realized exit timestamps must be strictly earlier than 2026-11-02T00:00:00Z

provisional_fresh_future_holdout.activation_rule: activated only after one preregistered candidate passes all 13 gates and a separate freeze-design audit registers its immutable SHA

fixed_signal_contract.negative_regime: SPY trailing-20-session return < 0 using decision-time data only
fixed_signal_contract.positive_behavior: exact V8 raw score on the first non-negative decision; no defensive exit buffer

selection_rule: A candidate is eligible only if all 13 gates pass. If multiple candidates pass, select the one with the lowest mean transition notional; break an exact tie by candidate_id lexical order. If none pass, decision is DO_NOT_FREEZE.
multiple_comparison_policy: The candidate set is fixed at three before evaluation. No weights, confirmation lengths, thresholds, costs, Top-N, holding periods, or gates may be changed after results are inspected.
